title: Modern Spacious Nash Retreat • 5 min to Broadway
description:
PRIME GERMANTOWN LOCATION | MINUTES TO BROADWAY

Located in Nashville’s trendy Germantown area, you’re just steps from popular restaurants, coffee shops, and the Nashville Farmers’ Market, Walk to downtown or take a quick Uber or Bird scooter ride to Broadway.

THE LOCATION
• 5 min to Broadway & Downtown
• 5 min to Nissan Stadium & Topgolf
• Walk to Germantown restaurants, breweries & the Nashville Farmers’ Market
• Near Bicentennial Park & Marathon Music Works
• 2car garage +free street parking

The space
WHAT YOU’LL LOVE

Perfect for bachelorette trips, family vacations, birthdays, golf weekends, concerts, and groups visiting Nashville.

• 🛏️ 9 Beds (including 1 sofa bed) – plenty of space for everyone
• 🚿 3.5 Bathrooms – no waiting to get ready
• 🍳 Fully stocked kitchen – perfect for group meals
• 📶 Fast WiFi + Smart TVs
• 🧺 In-unit washer & dryer
• 🚗 2-car garage + free street parking

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire home including the garage and laundry area.
Only the pantry/storage closet used for supplies will be locked.

Other things to note
•	Located in a safe, growing area with many nearby short-term rentals
